# Dhethi

> Dhethi is an independent product brand creating practical digital tools that are designed, shipped, and operated for real use.

## Product

- [JNTUH Connect](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/): A student utility spanning web, API, native Android, and native iOS experiences.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dhethi.jntuhconnect)
- [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/jntuh-connect/id6790828236)

## Product impact

- 4K+ daily active users.
- 22K+ API calls per day.
- 10K+ Google Play downloads.
- 12+ academic and career tools.
- Complete production footprint operated for under $14 per month.

## Product principles

- Start with a real, repeated problem.
- Own the complete path from interface to operations.
- Keep products dependable and economical to run.
- Improve through production signals and user feedback.
